prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1183; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache radiating to the occipital region. Initial examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, particularly in extension and rotation, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and no focal neurological deficits. Cervical radiographs showed no acute fracture or subluxation. A diagnosis of cervical strain consistent with whiplash-associated disorder was established.

Treatment consisted of a combination of manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise, and soft tissue mobilization, supplemented by home exercise instruction and postural education. Over the course of 28 visits, the patient demonstrated gradual improvement in range of motion, decreased paraspinal tenderness, and reduced frequency of headaches. Pain levels improved from moderate at initial presentation to mild at the most recent evaluation.

At discharge, the patient had regained near-full cervical range of motion with occasional stiffness during prolonged positioning. Residual symptoms are expected to continue improving with independent home exercise. Follow-up care is recommended on an as-needed basis should symptoms recur or worsen.
